HARDING HOUSE
Mrs. Harding greets you amiably. She is uncertain whether she 
should show you Gliere’s room. To try to Fast Talk her, go to 23; for 
Charm, go to 45, to use Persuade, go to 67; to try a bribe, go to 89.
(Arkham Location)
